Enum Class PixmProfile

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<PixmProfile>
org.openehealth.ipf.commons.ihe.fhir.pixpdq.PixmProfile
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<PixmProfile>, Constable, IheFhirProfile
public enum PixmProfile extends Enum<PixmProfile> implements IheFhirProfile
Enumeration of PIXm profile definitions for ITI-83 (Mobile Patient Identifier Cross-reference Query) and ITI-104 (Patient Identity Feed FHIR).

This enum defines the FHIR profiles used in the PIXm transactions, including the Parameters resources for input and output of the $ihe-pix operation and the Patient resource of the feed.

Since:
5.2
Author:
Christian Ohr
